items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: ...it was way better than Woody’s band that he had at the time... Him and Woody were the funniest guys I ever worked for.

ctx.x: Well we were talking about actually how you got started with big bands, but Woody Herman was your first big band?

No Ted Weems was my first big band, yeah, Ted Weems was. And then I played in a very good band after that, Buddy Morrow had a very good band when I worked with them, it was way better than Woody’s band that he had at the time, very good. Kenny Peplowski worked with Buddy. And he said the same thing. He says he’s a great guy to work with and always had a good band. But the band I was with was Dave on piano and Dick Johnson on alto, and Ray Diceo, and Rick Davis, a very good tenor player. We had a very good band, a…
